blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — AboitizPower-led Subic EnerZone Corporation has renewed its power distribution partnership with the Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority, extending its management of the Subic Bay Freeport Zone’s power distribution system for another 25 years.
